name: Sora Dawnscale
exported_coordinate_units: centimeters in independent temporary copies; source metres

textures.Normal: linear tangent; shallow low-frequency scale swatch
textures.ORM: linear R occlusion, G roughness, B metallic

source_brief.silhouette: A tall broad chest, short swept-back horns and an upright oval shield. A compact crest rises behind the forehead without adding wings or a tail.
source_brief.face: Pearl-gold scales, deep amber eyes and a short rounded muzzle. Keep the mouth closed at rest and use a calm expression, not a permanent display of teeth.
source_brief.costume: White-and-blue ceremonial armor with broad articulated panels, a short tabard and armored boots built around plantigrade feet.
source_brief.palette: Pearl #E0D8C1; royal blue #486A9A; gold #C4A367; dark slate #4D5B67.
source_brief.equipment: An oval fantasy shield with a single beacon gem and a short ceremonial mace. The gem is cosmetic outside the shield cast.
source_brief.signature: Swept horns, oval beacon shield and pale armored torso.
source_brief.materials: Matte scale normals at low frequency, brushed armor and one gem emissive mask. Do not model every scale.
source_brief.back: A short raised neck crest ends above the shoulders. No wings, tail or dangling cloth; clear shoulders make retargeting manageable.
source_brief.animation: Idle stands tall with the shield close. Walk uses slow deliberate steps. Basics strike compactly. The active angles the shield upward and lights the beacon disk before a protective shell forms.
source_brief.vfx: A pale-gold shield outline with a small vertical glint, never a full-screen column of light.
source_brief.audio: Low resonant chime and a measured armor movement; no roaring requirement.
source_brief.risk: Muzzle, neck crest and shoulder plates need a draconic rig review. Do not force a human head mesh under a scale texture.

equipment: Visual only; oval beacon shield and short ceremonial mace, fixed decorative gem
open_reviews: muzzle crest armor and weapon clearance
